nodes.label: Native Windows VM validation (UTM guest)
nodes.rationale: Validates the packaged native-Windows host without WSL against an authoritative UTM guest on the remote Mac. An x64 MSI exercised on Windows ARM is an emulation smoke only and does not close the x64-hardware gate.

nodes.label: ConPTY / Job Object runtime release gate
nodes.rationale: smoke.ps1 writes and observes a terminal marker, resizes, detaches/reattaches, kills only the broker, and requires the same mux-sessiond PID and terminal to survive — proving session persistence is independent of the broker process. Markers SUPERMUX_WINDOWS_BOOT_OK / SUPERMUX_TERM_E2E_OK / SUPERMUX_WINDOWS_E2E_OK gate the release.

nodes.label: Authenticated terminal path smoke (device token + scratch term)
nodes.rationale: Mints a device into devices.json using the DeviceStore sha256 scheme, seeds a session row directly into db.sqlite3 to avoid waiting on agent-spawn shim registration, then opens /ws/term with a Bearer token. Compiled mux-sessiond.exe is unreliable on Windows-on-ARM, so x64-baseline Bun is required for sessiond on ARM guests.

nodes.label: Windows validation evidence rules
nodes.rationale: Record Windows build, hardware architecture, Bun version/SHA-256 and every packaged executable's PE architecture and SHA-256; keep native and emulated results separate; stop at the first runtime release gate rather than making onboarding or real-agent claims on a broken terminal; never add agent credentials just for the test — record missing auth as an external gate.
